sermon.title: The Real Goal - March 17, 2024
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: Being saved from sin isn’t the goal; knowing God is. Joshua was chosen for his faithfulness and went up the mountain with Moses. God draws us directly, writes His law on our hearts, tore the veil, and calls us out to be holy, His special treasure and a kingdom of priests who serve rather than flaunt position. The service closes with personal commitments.

faqs.question: What should we look for in government?
faqs.answer: People who are wise, don’t take bribes, and act like they fear God.

faqs.question: What is his company like?
faqs.answer: It uses titles like supervisor two before you get to the top guy.

faqs.question: Is getting off an addiction the goal?
faqs.answer: No; the goal is to know God.

faqs.question: Why is God jealous?
faqs.answer: Like a spouse, He doesn’t want you spending time with the world.

faqs.question: What happens when people are told there is no God?
faqs.answer: They feel they have no value, formed from the dust of the cosmos.

faqs.question: What does he teach his son?
faqs.answer: To say back, “I am made I’m fearfully and wonderfully made I am made in the image of God.”

faqs.question: Did Jesus flaunt His power?
faqs.answer: No; He didn’t go around saying He can control the weather.

faqs.question: What if I come with no intention of changing?
faqs.answer: That is loving darkness rather than light.

faqs.question: What did members commit to?
faqs.answer: Serving the only true God and Him only.
